headlines.text: On this day in 2024, Mercedes Mone vs. Kris Statlander went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Full Gear, rated 8.57 ? a genuine showstealer. Mon? survived a leg-targeting attack from Statlander, capping a 20-minute classic with a rollup to retain the TBS Championship.

Back on this day in 2022, Chris Jericho vs. Tomohiro Ishii clashed for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.34 ? a fantastic contest. Tomohiro Ishii was challenging for gold for the very first time. Ishii's chops left Jericho's chest a bloody mess in their first-ever meeting, but Jericho escaped with the ROH World Title intact via the Liontamer.

Rewind to 2024, when a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Daniel Garcia vs. Jack Perry battled it out, appearing on Full Gear, rated 6.32 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Garcia locked in the Sharpshooter to defeat Perry and become the new TNT Champion after a match that saw Perry throw him through a table.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Bobby Lashley arrived in AEW against Swerve Strickland, appearing on Full Gear, rated 7.34 ? a good, competitive contest. Bobby Lashley made his AEW in-ring debut alongside the Hurt Syndicate, defeating Swerve Strickland in a hard-hitting brawl that included a table spot through the Spanish announce desk.

It was 2024 when Jay White chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a real marker of consistency, facing Jay White vs. Adam Page on Full Gear, rated 7.83 ? a match that delivered, part of the special Full Gear '24 card.

Turning the clock back to 2022: PAC reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Death Triangle vs. The Elite on Dynamite, rated 8.20 ? a genuinely great match in an action-packed trios battle, on an outstanding Thanksgiving Eve '22 show that earned an overall rating of 8.17.
